name: RMD-20 "Eye in the Sky" Series Monitoring Droid
wookieepedia_title: RMD-20 "Eye in the Sky" Series Monitoring Droid
description: The RMD-20 "Eye in the Sky" Series Monitoring Droid was a cheap, small droid that could follow a target, patrol an area, or be guided by commands sent to its built-in comlink. It was spherical with cameras arranged around it. It had no advanced sensors, and was basically a floating audio and visual transmitter. It was frequently used by civilians, but some cheaper police and military units would also field them.

data.name: RMD-20 "Eye in the Sky" Series Monitoring Droid
